Kupakṣakauśikāditya,_kauśikasahasrakiraṇa,
(kuvakkhako-siyasahassakiraNa or ºkosiyAicca) pravacanaparIkSA or sahasrakiraNa Śvet. Jain. Pkt. a polemic treatise against Dig. an. other Jain sects. in 11 chs. Composed in 1572-3 A. D. during the reign of Akbar. by Dharmasāgaragaṇi, pupil of Hīravijaya of Tapāgaccha.
BORI. 186 of 1871-72. BP. p. 279 (with C.). D. p.. 29. 192. 193 (with C. [Page197-a. in Skt.). 327. 359 (with C.). Gough p. 92. Jainagranthāvalī p. 159 (citations from his own C. ?). Leumann 95 (inc.). 96. Peters. I. p. 126 (no. 293). Weber 1976 (inc.). (with C.). For analysis of its contents, see BP. p.. 144-156. A. Weber, Sitzungsberichte der Preussischen Akademie der Wissenschaften in Berlin. 1882, p.. 793-914.
--C. by a. himself in Skt. BP. p. 279. D. p.. 193. 359. Weber 1976 (inc.).

Kupāla
Bud. See Kuśala.

Kupuṣpamālā
jy. Sūcīpattra 95.

Kuppaya
of Vogopi family.
--Śrīnivāsacampū, in 6 Gucchas, narrating the stories about Lord Śrīnivāsa of Tirupati hills. MD. 15802.

Kuppayabhaṭṭa
father of Peddisūri to whom a C. on Amarakośa (same a. that of Liṅgayasūri, son of Kāmaya Bhaṭṭa) is ascribed in one ms., MT. 2582. See NCC. I. p. 245b.

Kuppādīkṣita
father of Appaya Dīkṣita or Appā Dīkṣita alias Narasiṁhānandanātha (a. of Lalitāsahasranāmastotrabhāṣyasārasaṁgraha, Adyar).

Kuppādhvarin
son of Tippādhvarīndra of Bhāradvājagotra an. of a Telugu family of Tiruviśanallūr or Sāhajirājapuram; patronised by King Sahaji of Tanjore. C. 1700; elder brother of Cokkanātha; mentioned by the latter in his Kāntimatīpariṇaya or Kāntimatīśāharājīya, TD. 339. Sevantikāpariṇaya, MT. 2830. See also V. Raghavan, Intro. Sāhendravilāsa, Tanjore, p.. 39-40.

Kuppuśāstrin
--Paribhāṣābhāskara. gr. Oppert I. 5723. The P. bhā. is well-known a. a work of [Page197-b] Śeṣādrisudhī. From Adyar Library Bulletin VI. iii. p. 193, where a list of mss. in private possession is given, the Oppert entry may be taken a. ref. to a critique of P. bhā. by Kuppāśāstrin. The entry in the Adyar Library Bulletin reads: bhASyaM kuppAzAstrikRtaparibhASAbhAskaraM khaNDanagrantham.

Kūpakhananalakṣaṇa
jy. from Kālāmṛta. Adyar II. p. 55a. [Page262-a.

Kūpakhananavidhi
jy. RASB. III. 2827 (2 mss.).

Kūpakhātanirṇaya
jy. Ujjain I. p. 56.

Kūpacakra
jy. Allahabad 150. Mandlik Sup. 83. (iv).

Kūpacakravicāra
jy. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1897-1901, p. 200 (no. 817).

Kūpajataromaparidhānasūtra
Q. by Nāgārjuna, in his Daśabhūmivibhāṣāśāstra; title restored by R. Kimura. See IHQ. III. p. 417.

Kūpajalāśayotsarga(prayoga)
dh. on the dedication of wells an. tanks to the public. America 3004. Varendra 1928.

Kūpajalāśayotsargatattva

--from Smṛtikaustubha of Anantadeva (based on Śaunaka's treatise). TD. 13817. See NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 167a.
--from Hayaśīrṣapañcarātra. Varendra 688.

Kūpaśāntividhi

Kūpa(?)śāstra
mentioned by Bhoja a. a treatise on Kriyā-mārga, one of the arts pertaining to gambling. See V. Raghavan, Bhoja's Śṛṅgāra Prakāśa, p. 662.

Kūpārgala
